content.en: Delivered a seminar on "AI-Driven Research Programming: From Vibe Coding to Specification-Driven Practice" for the ABMind GSoC 2026 Mesa Training Program. The training aims to prepare Chinese developers for Google Summer of Code 2026 with Mesa framework.
content.zh: 为ABMind GSoC 2026 Mesa培训项目主讲"AI驱动科研编程：从Vibe Coding到规范驱动的实战指南"研讨会。该培训项目旨在帮助中国开发者准备2026年谷歌编程之夏（GSoC）Mesa框架相关提案。

content.en: Joined the CPGIS (International Association of Chinese Professionals in Geographic Information Science) as a student member and participated in the organization's election voting.
content.zh: 加入国际华人地理信息科学协会（CPGIS）成为学生会员，并参与了组织换届选举投票。

content.en: Congratulations to GISphere, a non-profit community, for successfully publishing three high-quality SCI papers on GIS education and research.
content.zh: 恭喜GISphere公益社群运营至今，顺利发表三篇高水平SCI论文，涉及GIS教育和研究领域。

content.en: Started Master's program in Geoinformatics Engineering at Politecnico di Milano, Italy.
content.zh: 开始在意大利米兰理工大学攻读地理信息工程硕士学位。

content.en: Completed WebGIS course project on air pollution analysis in Greece, featuring interactive maps and comprehensive data visualization.
content.zh: 完成WebGIS课程项目，对希腊空气污染进行分析，包含交互式地图和综合数据可视化。

content.en: Delivered presentation on "Spatial Data Analysis" at the GIS course, sharing insights on geospatial data processing and visualization techniques.
content.zh: 在GIS课程中发表"空间数据分析"报告，分享地理空间数据处理和可视化技术的见解。

content.en: Participated in Remote Sensing Applications workshop, focusing on satellite image processing and environmental monitoring.
content.zh: 参加遥感应用研讨会，专注于卫星图像处理和环境监测。
